newsitem.title: USA: AirNet to buy air freight forwarder.
newsitem.headline: AirNet to buy air freight forwarder.

text.p: AirNet Systems Inc said on Friday that it has signed a letter of intent to buy a domestic and international small package forwarder for about $2.1 million in AirNet common stock.
AirNet declined to release the name of the company, but said the acquisition would provide earnings accretion for fiscal 1997, which it began October 1.
The move would increase revenue by about $4 million a year and add 1,800 customers, AirNet said.
AirNet reported pro forma revenues of close to $20 million in the third quarter ending June 30.
AirNet said this was its first move into the small package business and that it hopes to develop its presence in the market both internally and through acquisitions.
The company said its proposed purchase is subject to conditions and that "there can be no assurance that the acquisition will be completed as currently planned."
